purpose: Activate the complete source-controlled production resource set as a playable Part I runtime rather than leaving assets as disconnected repository inventory.
activation_rules: Project-owned production assets are preferred over Engine BasicShapes whenever an imported asset resolves.
Every chapter receives production architecture, terrain, vegetation and clutter appropriate to its region.
Named cast and major threats keep their production mesh resolution paths.
Fallback primitives remain only as fail-safe runtime geometry when production imports are missing.
No story or quest trigger coordinates move in this pass.
Density stays deterministic and bounded for the 720p/30fps target laptop.

external_resource_boundary.policy: External downloads remain governed by Data/ExternalAssetManifest.json.
external_resource_boundary.rule: Do not silently ingest unlicensed, editorial, NC, ND, unknown-license or franchise-ripped resources.
external_resource_boundary.current_action: Activate all source-controlled project-owned resources now; separately acquired licensed/CC0 packs can drop into the existing Approved pipeline later.

runtime_work: Expand Shire production terrain/vegetation/clutter activation using the common kit.
Expand Bree production perimeter/street/inn clutter using the common kit.
Increase regional production use in P1C03-P1C08 without replacing mission topology.
Keep chapter router, quests, save/load, living-world events, dialogue and enemies active as one playable runtime.
Add CP52 validation guards so resource activation cannot regress back to disconnected assets.
